title: 第三章 大神教学第1招顺势而为第四章 大神教学第2招看牢危险因素
content_zh:
最新网址：一场闹剧之后，微微收了老大老二老四当徒弟。直接带着愚公移山小号，五个人一起刷本去了。
就是不吃饭：大跟班？你们认识微微么？咋就起了这么个名字啊！
老大黄涛看到这个信息，稍微考虑了下，还是决定还是暗示下贝微微。
微微的大跟班：哦，我们系有一个美女叫微微，那是我们的女神。
微微的二跟班：对，我们要保护女神，防止她被人给骗了！
芦苇微微：你们还是学生？
老二贾红海抬头郁闷的和黄涛说，“你说，系花咋就在游戏里结婚了呢？那个一笑奈何，让我总感觉莫名的危机感！”
这个时候，王跃刚巧从图书馆回来，一进门，听到老二的话后，随后就接自一句，“不就是肖奈吗？你怕他干啥？他还能找过来揍你咋的？”
“你说啥？”老大
“肖奈？”老二
“你咋知道的？”这是老四。
王跃突然反应过来，自己说漏嘴了，赶紧指着贾红海回怼，“不是老二说的肖奈吗？”
“我说的是一笑奈何！”老二蒙了三秒，急忙解释道。
“是啊！咦，肖奈，呵！”王跃重新的帮老二断句。
“你这么解读，竟然让我感觉到无懈可击！”老大若有所思的点了点头。
“如果是真的，那肖奈也够腹黑的啊！”老二也闻声附和。
“贝微微学姐深入简出的，很少能在外面碰上她。难道说老四遇见贝微微那天，肖奈也在？”老大若有所思的看向老，似乎是想从他哪里得到答案。
“那天是有看到肖奈啊，那也不可能这么巧啊！”老四还是不相信他们的猜测。
“你还是一个孩子，肖奈却是一个狐狸。”老二立马反驳。
“那是个见色起意的，腹黑狐狸。”老大十分确认。

王跃心里突然一动，电视里，肖奈好像就是这么腹黑，一路水到渠成的承包了鱼塘。要不，让老大他们提前给微微来个线下会面。看看狐狸是怎么处理意外事件的。
于是，王跃就不动声色的怂恿老大道，“老大，你们要不要私下给贝微微说说一下，你们是她大一学弟？”
“老三，没想到你也焉坏焉坏的啊？”老大看破了王跃的用意，不过还是一边说着，一边游戏里也开始打字。
私聊：微微的大跟班：我们是庆大计算机系大一的，我们老四见过你玩这个游戏。所以就来游戏里保护你来了。没想到还是晚了一步。
贝微微看到对方的回复，一脸的诧异？自己好像一直在寝室玩游戏，唯一一次就是在外面的网吧。
私聊：芦苇微微：是在网吧遇到的吧？小学弟这样可不好啊。
私聊：微微的大跟班：这不是我们老四被你和人比武的飒爽英姿迷住了吗？非要拜你为师。我和老二觉得就老四那憨憨，不一定能保护的了你，就赶紧也来帮忙了。
私聊：芦苇微微：就你们三个小号，还保护我？
私聊：微微的大跟班：我们是保护你不被人骗了，不过看起来好像晚了一步啊！你已经结婚了。
私聊：芦苇微微：我那有被骗，这个游戏里和奈何结婚，就是为了侠侣pk大赛。
私聊：微微的大跟班：那你知道，一笑奈何的现实身份吗？
私聊：芦苇微微：你知道大神的身份？！
私聊：微微的大跟班：根据我们宿舍老三的分析，他十有八九就是咱们系的肖奈。
私聊：芦苇微微：肖奈=一笑奈何？
私聊：微微的大跟班：我们老四说，他看到你那天，也同时看到了肖奈。
私聊：芦苇微微：这么巧？
私聊：微微的大跟班：有没有那种被狐狸盯上的感觉？
私聊：芦苇微微：肖奈是大神，你咋能说人家是狐狸！
私聊：微微的大跟班：他是全系男生的公敌！不对，是全校的！
content_en:
Latest website: After a farce, Weiwei accepted the boss, second, and fourth as apprentices. I took Yugong Yishan's trumpet directly, and the five of us went to refresh the book together.
Just don’t eat: Big follower? Do you know Weiwei? Why did you come up with such a name?
The boss Huang Tao saw this information, thought about it for a while, and decided to give Bei Weiwei a hint.
Weiwei’s big follower: Oh, there is a beauty in our department named Weiwei, she is our goddess.
Weiwei’s second follower: Yes, we must protect the goddess and prevent her from being deceived!
Luwei Weiwei: Are you still students?
The second child, Jia Honghai, raised his head and said to Huang Tao depressedly, "Tell me, why did Xihua get married in the game? That smile makes me feel inexplicably in danger!"
At this time, Wang Yue happened to come back from the library. As soon as he entered the door, after hearing what the second brother said, he then said to himself, "Isn't it Xiao Nai? What are you afraid of him for? How can he come and beat you up?"
"What did you say?" Boss
"Xiao Nai?" The second child
"How did you know?" This is the fourth child.
Wang Yue suddenly realized that he had spilled the beans, and quickly pointed at Jia Honghai and retorted, "Isn't it Xiao Nai that the second brother said?"
"I'm talking about nothing but a smile!" The second child was confused for three seconds and hurriedly explained.
"Yeah! Hey, Xiao Nai, ha!" Wang Yue finished the sentence for the second child again.
"Your interpretation makes me feel invulnerable!" The boss nodded thoughtfully.
"If it's true, then Xiao Nai is quite evil!" The second child also heard and agreed.
"Senior Sister Bei Weiwei goes deep into Jane's life and rarely meets her outside. Could it be that Xiao Nai was also there when the fourth child met Bei Weiwei?" The boss looked at him thoughtfully, as if he wanted to get an answer from him.
"I saw Xiao Nai that day, it couldn't be such a coincidence!" The fourth child still didn't believe their guess.
"You are still a child, but Xiao Nai is a fox." The second child immediately retorted.
"That's a scheming, sinister fox." The boss confirmed.
Wang Yue suddenly felt something in his heart. On TV, Xiao Nai seemed to be so sinister, and he successfully contracted the fish pond. Otherwise, ask the boss and the others to meet Weiwei offline in advance. See how the fox handles unexpected events.
So, Wang Yue calmly encouraged Lao Dadao, "Boss, do you want to tell Bei Weiwei in private that you are her freshman students?"
"Third brother, I didn't expect you to be so bad, huh?" The boss saw through Wang Yue's intentions, but he still started typing in the game while talking.
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: We are freshmen in the Department of Computer Science at Qingda University, and our fourth brother has seen you play this game. So I came to protect you in the game. Unexpectedly, it was still a step too late.
Bei Weiwei looked surprised when he saw the other party's reply? It seems that I have been playing games in the dormitory, and the only time I have been is in the Internet cafe outside.
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: We met in an Internet cafe, right? This is not good for a junior high school student.
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: Isn’t it that our fourth child is fascinated by your brave and heroic appearance in fighting with others? I must worship you as my teacher. The second child and I felt that the foolish fourth child might not be able to protect you, so we hurriedly came to help.
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: It’s just you three trumpets, and you’re still protecting me?
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: We are protecting you from being cheated, but it seems like we are a step too late! You are already married.
Private chat: Lu Wei Weiwei: I was deceived. In this game, I married Naihe just for the Heroes PK competition.
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: Do you know Yixiao Naihe’s real identity?
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: Do you know the identity of the great god? !
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: According to the analysis of the third child in our dormitory, he is most likely Xiao Nai from our department.
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: Xiao Nai = oneWhat's the point of laughing?
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: Our fourth child said that the day he saw you, he also saw Xiao Nai.
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: What a coincidence?
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: Do you ever feel like you’re being watched by a fox?
Private chat: Luwei Weiwei: Xiao Nai is a great god, how can you call someone a fox!
Private chat: Weiwei’s big follower: He is the public enemy of all the boys in the department! No, it’s the whole school!
